expressions.bm_formal: Biar saya semak dahulu. / Saya akan menyemak.
expressions.bm_casual: Kejap, saya check. / Nanti saya check.

expressions.en: Thank you for your cooperation. / Thanks for helping.
expressions.cn: 感谢您的合作。/ 谢谢你的帮忙。
expressions.bm_formal: Terima kasih atas kerjasama anda. / Penghargaan atas bantuan anda.
expressions.bm_casual: Thanks sebab tolong. / Terima kasih banyak-banyak.

expressions.en: I will follow up. / I'll get back to you.
expressions.cn: 我会跟进。/ 我会再联系你。
expressions.bm_formal: Saya akan membuat susulan. / Saya akan maklumkan semula kepada anda.
expressions.bm_casual: Nanti saya follow up. / Saya update awak balik.

work.scenario: Your manager needs an urgent sales report. You are compiling the data and will send it soon.
key_phrases: Bolehkah anda menghantar laporan itu kepada saya?

life.scenario: A friend asks if you can pick them up from the airport, but you might be slightly late due to unexpected traffic.

tech.scenario: You're calling customer support because your internet is down. The technician needs to check your connection and will call you back with an update.
key_phrases: Bolehkah anda semak sambungan internet saya?

quiz_toggle.question: How do you formally ask 'Could you please send me the report?' in Malay?
quiz_toggle.answer: Bolehkah anda menghantar laporan itu kepada saya?
